title: Unit 16 Gases (part 2)
textbookText: Section ‘C’ Short answer type questions 1. Ammonia gas can be prepared by heating two solid substances in laboratory. Answer the following questions: i) Name two solids used in it. Ans:- The two solids used to prepare ammonia gas are NH₄Cl and Ca(OH)₂. ii) Write one use of the gas. Ans:- Ammonia gas is used for making fertilizers and cleaning purposes. 2. Why is lime tower used for the preparation of ammonia in laboratory? Ans:- Lime tower is used in the preparation of ammonia to absorb moisture and purify the gas. It ensures that the collected ammonia is dry and free from water vapour. 3. When CO2 gas is passed into lime water continuously, why does lime water turn milky initially and then become clear ofter sometime? Ans:- Lime water turns milky initially due to the formation of CaCO₃. It becomes clear on continued passage of CO₂ because CaCO₃ reacts with excess CO₂ to form soluble Ca(HCO₃)₂. 4. Which chemical is used to obtain dry ammonia gas? Why? Ans:- NH₄Cl is used to obtain dry ammonia gas because it reacts with Ca(OH)₂ on heating to release ammonia. The reaction is easy to perform and yields ammonia gas efficiently. 5. What happens if ammonia gas is passed into water containing few drops of phenolphthalein? Why? Ans:- If ammonia gas is passed into water containing phenolphthalein, the solution turns pink. This is because ammonia is basic in nature and phenolphthalein shows pink in basic solution. 6. It is dangerous to clean well remaining closed for a long time, why? Ans:- It is dangerous to clean a well remaining closed for a long time because toxic gases like CO₂ and H₂S may accumulate. These gases can cause suffocation when inhaled. 7. Which gas is collected in laboratory by downward displacement of air? Why? Ans:- CO₂ gas is collected by downward displacement of air because it is heavier than air. This method prevents the gas from escaping into the atmosphere. 8. Carbon dioxide gas is used in fire extinguisher, why? Ans:- Carbon dioxide gas is used in fire extinguishers because it does not support combustion and can smother the fire. It displaces oxygen around the flame, putting out the fire. 9. Carbon dioxide gas neither burns itself nor helps to burn other substances, however it extinguishes the burning substances but a burning magnesium ribbon is introduced into a jar containing carbon dioxide it burns continuously, why? Give chemical equation also. Ans:- Carbon dioxide extinguishes burning substances, but a burning magnesium ribbon burns in CO₂ because Mg reacts with CO₂ to form MgO and C. The chemical equation is 2Mg + CO₂ → 2MgO + C. 10. Write any two uses of carbon dioxide gas. Ans:- Two uses of carbon dioxide gas are in fire extinguishers and to make soft drinks fizzy. It is also used in the manufacture of dry ice. 11. Write down any two uses of ammonia gas. Ans:- Two uses of ammonia gas are making fertilizers like ammonium sulphate and cleaning agent in household cleaning. It is also used in the manufacture of nitric acid.

12. Mention any two methods for testing carbon dioxide gas in laboratory. Ans:- Two methods for testing carbon dioxide gas are passing it through lime water to turn it milky and bubbling it through aqueous NaOH to form Na₂CO₃. 13. How does air pollution causes acid rain? Write any one chemical reaction. Ans:- Air pollution causes acid rain when SO₂ and NO₂ from the air dissolve in rainwater forming acids. One reaction is SO₂ + H₂O → H₂SO₃. 14. What happens when carbon dioxide is passed through lime water for a long time? Write with equation. Ans:- When carbon dioxide is passed through lime water for a long time, the milky CaCO₃ dissolves to form soluble Ca(HCO₃)₂. The reaction is CaCO₃ + CO₂ + H₂O → Ca(HCO₃)₂. 15. The bottle of liquid ammonia should be placed in cold water or ice for some time before opening its lid. Why? Ans:- The bottle of liquid ammonia is placed in cold water before opening because ammonia is highly volatile and under pressure. Cooling reduces pressure and prevents sudden release of gas.
